_readme: Copy this folder to projects/<name>/ and fill in. Paths are repo-relative or absolute. See charvid_project.py for the full new-book checklist.

persona._readme: Protagonist persona cluster. map: tag -> [display label, portrait file]. base_flips: chapter-anchored progression of the DEFAULT persona (applied in order). image_names: portrait files reserved for the protagonist (excluded from the general roster). Leave map/base_flips empty if the protagonist has one fixed portrait.
persona.protagonist_prefix: <Protagonist first name, used to group persona labels in reports>

_default_image_note: Optional filename (in portraits_dir) shown when a scene's cast has NO portraits. Unset -> the previous frame is held instead.
